reason: A DeepSeek Harness conversation-management plugin that adds a session manager panel, archive and unarchive controls, and confirmed irreversible deletion of sessions and their stored files.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话管理面板，并支持归档、取消归档以及经确认后删除会话及其存储文件。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness session manager panel with archive, unarchive, and confirmation-based deletion of conversations and their stored files.

capabilities: Deletes conversation sessions and their on-disk JSONL directories after confirmation
Interrupts and disposes running agents during session deletion
Exposes host-side HTTP endpoints for deletion and unarchiving
Provides a session manager panel with filtering and per-session actions
